title: PlotX
description: This plugin transforms field protection by eliminating technical commands and replacing them with an immersive experience. Through holographic interfaces, it allows you to manage pieces intuitively and directly on the playing field.
body:
# 🛡️ PlotX: The Next-Gen Holographic Protection
“Redefining land protection: Where aesthetics meet absolute security.”

PlotX isn’t just another land protection plugin; it’s a complete visual experience for your players. Forget complex commands and confusion over property boundaries. With a system based on Energy Cores, dynamic holograms, and real-time particles, PlotX makes managing a property as intuitive as playing the game.

## Dependencies requires
- Vault 
- ProtocolLib 
- PlaceholderAPI

##  ✨ Key Features
## 💎 Holographic Energy Cores
Each protection is powered by a central core. When placed, it generates a dynamic   
- The owner’s name.
- The protection’s status.
- Real-time expiration time.
- Quick access to land settings.

## 🌐 Particle-Based Boundary Visualization
Tired of using wires or commands to see where your house ends?

- Clear Boundaries: A particle system that marks the exact perimeter.
- No External Tools: Visible directly in the world to the owner and members.
- Total Immersion: Boundaries adapt to the terrain for maximum clarity.


## 🔐 Granular Permission Control
Manage exactly what happens in your world with a highly configurable flag system:

- Interactions: Control the use of doors, chests (containers), and redstone.
- Combat: Enable or disable PvP, projectile damage, and mob damage.
- Construction: Protect every block from unwanted guests.
# 🛠️ Technical Specifications

## 📊 Integration with PlaceholderAPI
Take your player data anywhere (TabList, Scoreboards, Menus) with our built-in placeholders:

- **%protection_nucleos%**: Current number of cores.

- **%protection_expansiones%**: Total expanded land.

- **%protection_max_nucleos%**: Maximum allowed limit.

## 📂 Advanced Log Management
Security is our top priority. PlotX features an asynchronous LogManager that records every important event without impacting server performance:

> **Automatic file rotation to prevent files from becoming too large.**

> **Detailed logging of deletions and ownership changes.**

> **Storage organized by date and user in .yml format.**

## Performance and Persistence

> SQLite Database: Ultra-fast loading and saving with support for safe restarts.

> Flexible Time Processor: Supports natural time formats (1d, 12h, 30m).

> Asynchronous: Most resource-intensive operations are executed outside the main thread to ensure zero TPS loss.

### 🚀Quick Start Guide
1. **Protecting a chunk:** The player must Shift-left-click on the block of the selected chunk

2. **Opening the hologram:** To open the protection hologram, you must be inside your already-protected area and right-click with the item in your hand in the direction where you want it to be placed

3. **Invite a player:** To invite a player to your protection, you must be in your central protection or expansion, and the player must be near you. Open the hologram, select the “Friends” option, and the player’s nickname will appear


_PlotX is designed for servers looking for a modern, user-friendly experience. Give your players the tool they deserve._
